hazard_exposure.population_dataset: JRC GHSL GHS-WUP-POP R2025A, epoch 2025, authoritative ~1 km source
hazard_exposure.wildfire_rule: burned area >= 10,000 ha; population in burned polygon and within 5 km
hazard_exposure.storm_rule: CEMS activation OR GDACS Orange/Red OR populated GDACS TC footprint; EONET-only fallback uses populated 300 km center buffer
hazard_exposure.interpretation: Potential population exposure; not observed impact, casualties, attribution, or loss
hazard_exposure.drought_rule: GHSL 2025 population inside the latest GDACS drought event polygon; no radius buffer
